Definition: an encountering, accidental, friendly or hostile (also adverbially, opposite)
BiblicalUsage: David sends men to meet the shamed ambassadors at Jericho and tell them to tarry till their beards are grown, and he reminds Shimei that he came down to meet him at Jordan. The word is the encountering itself, friendly or hostile, as the meeting turns.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe meeting is never neutral in Scripture: men come to meet a king, and the meeting decides things.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
